title: 10/10 would recommend!
text: We loved our tour with Kat! She was very warm and friendly and had interesting facts/stories to share about all of the art she pointed out on the tour. She showed us so many things that we continued to notice and look out for throughout our trip. It was a great way to get to know the neighbourhood and notice things we never would have seen on our own. She also had great recommendations for other things to do in Barcelona. Highly recommend!!
author: margog369

title: cool factor paired with friendly and insightful guide
text: Fantastic!  Tour guide (and owner) is wonderful, super-knowledgable about the street art community and culture, with an academic background in art history -- great combo!  Entire 2 hours was filled with insight that I could not have gotten any other way.  Very enjoyable time, highly recommend
author: Megan_G

title: Amazing tour

title: Great way to learn about the city, excellent guide!
text: This was a great way to  learn about the city on our 1st day in town. Our guide was very engaging and knowledgeable, and we got to see some great art! Fun experience!
author: jillmX7934GL

title: What a unique way to...
text: What a unique way to experience Barcelona! Highly recommend if you want to see parts of Barcelona that are less common. Luke knows an incredible amount about each piece and his passion resonates through this experience. Probably a highlight of my trip in Barcelona
author: Destiny_M

title: Great tour, friendly guide, interesting insights
text:
Luke was very friendly and easy-going, quick to answer questions online (both before and after the tour), tailored the tour to our interests and even spent more time on our tour than we'd booked. He knew what he was talking about and showed us the hidden gems we probably wouldn't have found (or understood) on our own.
The artists at the studio were also very friendly; they showed us what they were currently working on and told us about their work in general, which was also very interesting.
author: 260julianer

title: Great street art tour followed by a visit to a studio
text: The tour with Luke was really great, super interesting and just great. Luke knows his way around, showed us great corners, even away from the usual tourism, and always left enough time for photos, questions or anything else on our minds. The absolute highlight for me was the visit to the studio 😊 being able to talk to the artists was really nice! I highly recommend the tour!!
author: jenniferbV4516HW

title: Loved this tour!
text: Great tour!  Kat was a wonderful guide and we learned so much about the Barcelona art scene. Highly recommend.
